standards.title: Built to feel clear, premium, and cross-border ready.
standards.desc: The marketplace now uses a stronger international UX language: structured verification, documented handoff rules, and buyer protection copy that feels closer to a modern global platform than a local classifieds board.
standards.card1_desc: Listing, identity, and condition details are framed in a way that international buyers expect from premium resale platforms.
standards.card2_desc: Product pages emphasize specs, warranty, fulfillment details, and seller credibility instead of relying on short descriptions.
standards.card3_desc: Pickup, courier, and post-sale follow-up are presented as a guided flow, reducing friction for higher-value transactions.
standards.card4_desc: The interface now highlights service quality, response expectations, and support coverage across the full buyer journey.

trust.desc: Clear operating standards make the marketplace feel reliable well beyond a basic local listing site.
trust.step1_desc: Account type, listing intent, and identity signals are captured before inventory goes live.
trust.step2_desc: Condition notes, specs, warranty, and media are positioned as a structured pre-sale inspection story.
trust.step3_desc: Buyers reserve with more confidence thanks to clearer purchase language, review context, and fulfillment guidance.
trust.step4_desc: The platform sets expectations around delivery, response time, and post-sale issue handling from the start.
trust.buyer_protection_desc: Clear pricing, inspection context, and warranty copy reduce ambiguity before payment is committed.
trust.seller_standards_desc: Verified seller treatment and profile trust signals now feel closer to a premium managed marketplace.
trust.dispute_handling_desc: Support and follow-up language make conflict resolution part of the product experience, not an afterthought.
trust.international_tone_desc: Typography, content hierarchy, trust blocks, and information density are moving toward the feel of an export-ready platform.

seo.title: GoodCheck | Trusted Marketplace for Pre-Owned Computer Gear
seo.description: Inspection-led marketplace for premium pre-owned computer gear. Every listing is verified with a 30-point quality review before handoff.
tour.welcome_desc: Take a quick tour to discover how GoodCheck makes buying and selling premium pre-owned gear simple and secure.
tour.step1_desc: Explore verified products with detailed specs, warranty info, and seller trust signals.
tour.step2_desc: Use powerful filters to narrow down by category, price, condition, and location.
tour.step3_desc: Toggle between English and Thai using the language switcher in the navigation bar.
tour.step4_desc: View prices in Thai Baht or US Dollars with the currency toggle.
tour.step5_desc: Sign in to place orders, message sellers, and manage your favorites. Happy shopping!
